{{Quote|But they were supposed to go to the Palanhi system. Yes. An error on my part. Obviously, something more important came than their concerns for Ackbar's reputation.|[[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]|<ref name="Dark Force Rising">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref>}}
The '''Palanhi system''' was a [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Star system/Legends|system]] in the [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]] in the [[Bakchou arm]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Palanhi/Legends|Palanhi]]. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Harbid]] participated in an unsuccessful operation to capture [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] in the Palanhi system in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]].
